name: Racing Assists
source: [AS] Grade table proposal (assists plan I1, vault PHYS-074; owner approved the grade mapping 2026-10-12): Racing = traction control Off/On/Relaxed/Sport/Drift, plus launch control (assists I4) and aero automation (assists I5: the rear-wing law of racing_game core/src/session.cpp with its rg/environment.h defaults [D]; launch_offset_deg 10 is [AS] = the car_hyper maximum-downforce offset 9-11 deg [D]; default_enabled true [AS, owner: Racing = aero automation]). Mode 'on' is the car's own traction_control block. Per-mode values are assumed starting points (plan B1 table), measured against the V6 ordering band in tests/unit/test_assist_unit.cpp. Assists I4 (D-LC1): launch_control block - launch_rpm 4500 is car_hyper's value (owner Q7; a car with another engine attaches an 'extends' variant of this file with its own launch_rpm, or a unit with launch_rpm_fraction like the Sport unit); arming, release, hand-over, ramp and the per-mode slip targets are the owner's Q7 [AS] defaults (throttle > 0.9, brake > 0.5, release below 0.2, speed < 0.5 m/s, hand-over at 6 m/s or 3 s, clutch ramp 0.25 s, slip targets On 0.10 / Sport 0.14 / Drift 0.2, Relaxed 0.12 between On and Sport [AS]); the slip speed floor 1 m/s, the PI gains (TC mode On's values), min_fraction 0.05 and the clutch regulator rates (clutch_up_per_s 6, clutch_down_per_s 12) are [AS], measured on car_hyper on asphalt; default_enabled false [AS] so a car carrying the unit launches as before until the assist is switched on.
